# ADR 0003: Mutual TLS between services

← [Architecture](../README.md) · [Capstone brief](../../README.md)

- **Status:** Accepted
- **Capstone:** Interbank transfer gRPC service

## Context

Only member banks may call the switch.

## Decision

Each service has a certificate from a private CA; servers require client certificates.

## Consequences

Strong service identity. Certificate rotation must be automated.

## Alternatives considered

Shared API keys; network allow-lists only.
